source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Engine Electrical, p.6Y-15

procedures.title: Field relay: check and adjust
steps: If regulator voltage is above the closing voltage spec and the lamp stays on, the field relay is bad; check and adjust it (see specifications).
Closing voltage: connect a 50 ohm variable resistor in series between a hot lead and the relay coil (see figure 13c in the manual).
Set the resistor to open.
Turn the ignition off.
Slowly reduce resistance and note the voltage at which the relay closes.
Adjust by bending the heel iron (see figure 14c in the manual).

procedures.title: Charging harness: other wire checks
steps: Check each remaining wire for continuity with an ohmmeter or a 12 volt test light, putting the wire in series in the test circuit.

procedures.title: Delcotron generator: remove and install
steps: Disconnect the battery ground strap at the battery so the diodes are not damaged.
Disconnect the wiring at the Delcotron.
Remove the generator brace bolt; with power steering, loosen the pump brace and mount nuts. Take off the drive belt(s).
Support the generator, remove the mount bolt (the 6.2" Delcotron has 2) and lift it out.
Install in reverse order, then adjust the drive belt.
notes: Service operations cover the 5.5" aluminum and 6.2" perforated stator Delcotrons.

procedures.title: Delcotron pulley: replace
steps: 5.5" Delcotron, single groove: hold the shaft with a 5/16" allen wrench in its end while turning the nut off with a 15/16" box wrench (see figure 15c in the manual).
Remove the washer, then slide the pulley, fan and spacer off the shaft.
Install in reverse, using a torque wrench with a crow-foot adapter to tighten the nut to 50 ft. lbs.
Double groove: put a 15/16" socket with wrench flats (or Adapter J-21501 and a box wrench) on the nut, pass a 5/16" allen wrench through into the shaft hex to hold it, and remove the nut.
Remove the washer and slide off the pulley, fan and spacer.
To install, slide on spacer, fan, pulley and washer and start the nut.
Tighten the nut to 50 ft. lbs. with the socket, adapter and a torque wrench.

procedures.title: Delcotron brushes: replace (6.2" Delcotron)
steps: Remove the 2 nuts holding the blade connectors and take off the connectors (see figure 17c in the manual); slide the indicator light relay wire off its post.
Remove the 2 screws holding the capacitor and brush holder to the rear end frame and remove the brush holder.
Leave the capacitor with the generator; its lead is connected inside and should not be strained.
